extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: A visual question answering dataset sourced from online question answering community forums, with authentic questions, context, and accepted answers. It is designed to study long-form VQA answers and evaluation metrics for them.
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, and Danna Gurari
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We created our dataset by scraping data from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange. We used the publicly-available data that spanned from August 2010 to November 2022. From the Stack Exchange archive, we collected all examples containing four components: a natural language question, a natural language context, an image, and at least one answer.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Examples were filtered out if they lacked an accepted answer, had scores of 0 or less for either the question or answer, had multiple images, had visual answers, or if the image could not be downloaded from the provided link.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Publicly available Stack Exchange archive data in XML format, hosted at archive.org/details/stackexchange, containing visual questions with a natural language question, natural language context, image URL, and answers.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Ten domain experts were hired to evaluate visual questions for ten topics. They received a one-on-one training session to introduce the task and instructions, and were given contact information for questions and feedback. The authors also monitored time spent per question as a quality control proxy.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A web-based annotation tool (code available on GitHub).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Spearman correlation scores were reported for evaluation metrics against human judgments.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: One domain expert per topic/item in the expert evaluation setup.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Domain experts located in the United States to ensure English proficiency.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering steps removed low-quality VQAs based on scores, examples without accepted answers, with multiple images, with visual answers, and images that could not be downloaded; all images were converted to png format.
